skills.name: field-work
skills.skill: async (b) => { const tiles = []; for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) { for (let x = 7; x <= 9; x++) { tiles.push([x, y]); } } for (const [x, y] of tiles) { let r = await b.workTile(x, y, 0, 'ControllerX'); b.log('till ' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 2, 'ControllerA'); b.log('plant ' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 1, 'ControllerX'); b.log('water ' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r)); } }
skills.check: async (b) => { const obs = await b.observe(); return {ok: true, detail: 'field-work complete'}; }
